name: Avatar
summary: A person's photo or initials in a circle.
rungReason: for a photo; initials are an image too (role="img" with the name), so they're read as the person, not as letters.

attributes.alt: the name, or empty when decorative

a11y.name: The person's name, or nothing when the name is written beside it

keyboard.action: Passes over it: it takes no focus

props.name: the alt text or label
props.decorative: hide it when the name is beside it

rules: Decorative next to a visible name, so the name isn't read twice
Initials are the first letters of the first and last words
withoutJavaScript: Works fully; a photo that fails to load shows its alt text
